concerns.text: T014 depends on T011 (regulatory BED) and T018 on T010b (reference genome), but neither T011 nor T010b has a task entry, deliverable spec, or verification criterion in this document — they appear only as names in the 'Revision behavior' note. An implementer picking up this tasks.md cannot execute T014/T018 because the required input artifacts (regulatory BED path, reference genome FASTA path) are undefined. Add task entries (or explicit artifact-path declarations) for T011/T010b outputs.

T014 validates against 'specs/001-gene-regulation/contracts/snp_schema.schema.yaml', but the contract files live under 'specs/001-systematic-assessment-of-non-coding-vari/contracts/'. The referenced path does not exist, so the schema-validation step is unexecutable as written. Fix all contract paths to the actual directory.

T025 requires 'enrichment ratios of high-impact SNPs in GWAS loci vs expected overlap (SC-003)' while conforming to enrichment_result_schema.schema.yaml — but that schema has no observed_overlap/expected_overlap/enrichment_ratio fields (they live in enrichment_schema.schema.yaml / result_schema.schema.yaml) and forbids additionalProperties. The task as specified cannot both conform to the named schema and record the SC-003 evidence. Name the correct schema or reconcile the three conflicting result schemas.

T008's verification — 'a clean re-run reproduces identical result files given the fixed seed' — is unexecutable given T027 mandates fetching the GWAS Catalog 'file with most recent modification timestamp at runtime', which changes between runs and makes byte-identical reproduction impossible. Either pin the GWAS file version/checksum for re-runs or scope the reproducibility check to derived outputs excluding the raw GWAS fetch.

Verification runs 'find code data tests -type f' (lists FILES) but then claims 'the verifier checks this file lists every required DIRECTORY'. A file listing cannot contain directory entries; the check as written always fails. Specify directory-level listing (e.g. 'find ... -type d') or check for the sentinel __init__.py/.gitkeep files per required directory.

The sensitivity sweep is specified as 'a range of bit values' with no concrete range or step count (e.g. 0.5–4 bits in 0.5-bit steps). Without a defined sweep set, the deliverable data/results/sensitivity_cutoff_sweep.json has no deterministic content specification.

The end-to-end checkpoint says outputs 'can be spot-checked against manual calculations on 3 SNPs' without naming which 3 SNPs, which TFs, or where the expected values are recorded. Make it concrete: name the fixture SNPs/TFs and require expected values in the test file (e.g. tests/integration/test_e2e_spotcheck.py).
